docker run --name argo-hp-p0-trusted-data-verify-v1 --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --user 501:20 --cpus 1 --memory 512m --memory-swap 512m --pids-limit 64 --ulimit cpu=30:30 --ulimit fsize=8388608:8388608 --ulimit nofile=256:256 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=64m,mode=1777 --log-driver local --log-opt max-size=1m --log-opt max-file=1 --log-opt compress=false --mount type=bind,source=/Users/um-yunsang/.cache/argo-research/house-price-p0/trusted-input-v1/train.csv,target=/input/train.csv,readonly --mount type=bind,source=/Users/um-yunsang/.cache/argo-research/house-price-p0/trusted-preparation-v1/data,target=/prepared,readonly sha256:cd43d0d8edac942bd67cd097caf08edd2def45016bf011c1635849f15ebc7835 python -B -c 'import csv, hashlib, io, json
from pathlib import Path
import sklearn
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
EXPECTED_SOURCE="1e18addf81e5e4d347cc17ee6075bbe4a42b7fa26b9e5b063e8f692a5f929d41"
source=Path("/input/train.csv").read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==EXPECTED_SOURCE and len(source)==460676
original=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(source.decode("utf-8"),newline=""),strict=True))
header=original[0];table=original[1:]
assert len(table)==1460 and len(header)==81 and len(set(header))==81
assert all(len(row)==81 for row in table)
id_column=header.index("Id");target_column=header.index("SalePrice")
ids=[row[id_column] for row in table];assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))==1460
train,dev=train_test_split(list(range(1168)),test_size=0.25,random_state=1,shuffle=True,stratify=None)
groups={"inner_train":train,"dev":dev,"outer_train":list(range(1168)),"hidden":list(range(1168,1460))}
assert set(train).isdisjoint(dev) and set(train)|set(dev)==set(range(1168))
root=Path("/prepared");manifest=json.loads((root/"public_manifest.json").read_bytes())
assert manifest["source_sha256"]==EXPECTED_SOURCE and manifest["split"]["sklearn_version"]==sklearn.__version__=="1.6.1"
assert manifest["counts"]=={"all":1460,"outer_train":1168,"inner_train":876,"dev":292,"hidden":292}
allowed={"train_inner.csv","dev_features.csv","dev_targets.csv","train_outer.csv","hidden_features.csv","hidden_targets.csv","dev_ids.json","hidden_ids.json","public_manifest.json"}
assert {p.name for p in root.iterdir()}==allowed
feature_columns=[i for i in range(81) if i!=target_column]
checks={}
for name,row in manifest["files"].items():
    data=(root/name).read_bytes()
    assert len(data)==row["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row["sha256"]
    checks[name]={"sha256":row["sha256"],"bytes":len(data)}
for group,indices in groups.items():
    actual_ids=[table[i][id_column] for i in indices]
    expected_hash=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(actual_ids,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest()
    assert manifest["ordered_id_sha256"][group]==expected_hash
    if group in {"inner_train","outer_train"}:
        name="train_inner.csv" if group=="inner_train" else "train_outer.csv"
        rows=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO((root/name).read_text(),newline=""),strict=True))
        assert rows==[header,*[table[i] for i in indices]]
    else:
        features=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO((root/(group+"_features.csv")).read_text(),newline=""),strict=True))
        targets=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO((root/(group+"_targets.csv")).read_text(),newline=""),strict=True))
        assert features==[[header[i] for i in feature_columns],*[[table[j][i] for i in feature_columns] for j in indices]]
        assert "SalePrice" not in features[0]
        assert targets==[["Id","SalePrice"],*[[table[j][id_column],table[j][target_column]] for j in indices]]
        assert json.loads((root/(group+"_ids.json")).read_bytes())==actual_ids
print(json.dumps({"schema_version":"argo-house-price-preparation-independent-content-check/v1","status":"PASS","source_sha256":EXPECTED_SOURCE,"counts":manifest["counts"],"ordered_id_sha256":manifest["ordered_id_sha256"],"files":checks,"sklearn_version":sklearn.__version__,"exact_original_row_correspondence":True,"feature_targets_absent":True,"raw_values_printed":False,"fits":0,"scores":0},sort_keys=True))
'
